summary: Milestone 2026.09.635 completed 12 experiments in 98.1 minutes, including 5 compute-bound experiments. The two longest compute-bound entries were Live ARC adapter-withheld cumulative session A at 43.26 minutes and session B at 40.47 minutes; no data available this milestone explains their internal phase cost.
bottlenecks_identified: Elapsed time was concentrated in Live ARC adapter-withheld cumulative sessions A and B, but the supplied evidence has no phase breakdown that explains why.
Disk-modification-time reconstruction recovers durations but does not attribute time to setup, model loading, inference, validation, or artifact writing.
Task-correlated accelerator samples, concurrent-model counts, and runner-selection receipts are absent, preventing an audit of compute-window efficiency and dispatch eligibility.
The 13.18-minute synthesis-only quality comparison was the next-largest listed duration; its zero-GPU behavior is expected and is not an accelerator bottleneck.
improvements_suggested: Emit monotonic start, finish, and phase timestamps for setup, model loading, inference, validation, and artifact writing.
Capture device allocation and GPU utilization between each compute-bound task's start and finish, tagged to that task.
Record concurrent-model count, independence eligibility, device assignment, and runner choice; invoke DualGPURunner only for confirmed parallel multi-model work.
Add an eligibility-aware work queue that can place independent compute experiments on separate GPUs when safe.
Persist event-based milestone timing so future retrospectives do not depend on disk modification times.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the Live ARC session path with phase timers and task-aligned GPU samples.
Add eligibility-aware device scheduling for independent compute experiments.
Persist model-count, device-assignment, runner-choice, and event-timing receipts in each experiment artifact.
meta_reflection: The runtime ranking identifies where to investigate, but not why the leaders were slow. Future retrospectives should require phase, compute-window GPU, model-count, and runner receipts before attributing inefficiency or estimating savings.
